title: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition: attackers can read or change files
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 57 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public. The severity score is critical (10.0). The exploit prediction score is 97%.

category.label: Developer tools
category.why: It holds source code and the keys used to build and ship software.
category.doThis: Patch it. If it faced the internet, change the keys and passwords stored in it.

summary: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 14, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
